claim_one_line: THE SPECIALIST REGISTER REVISITED: TWO OF SEVEN WERE NEVER SPECIALIST GATES, AND THE HIGHEST-WEIGHT ONE IS NOW SUBSTANTIALLY DISCHARGED. The owner's thesis -- that NEEDS-SPECIALIST labels are relative and conditional, assigned when the framework was thinner and the seat was misinformed in many shapes -- is the absence-stamp lesson extended: A SPECIALIST GATE HAS A DATE TOO, exactly as the corpus already locks for absence claims. Reading OPEN_LEADS' 'Specialist hand-off register (terminal NEEDS-SPECIALIST -- in-sandbox computation exhausted)' against that thesis, TWO of its seven rows are not specialist gates at all but LITERATURE gates written when this seat had no search: B391, whose row itself says the needed local-theta-correspondence proof is 'plausibly already in the literature' (Gelbart/Prasad neighborhood), untested; and B264/B274/B347, the E6 character variety of 4_1, which asks for 'specialist confirmation of novelty' resting on a sweep dated 2026-07-04. REVISITED THE HIGH-WEIGHT ONE, whose row says the first-computation claim is 'publication-shaped if confirmed': two independent searches confirm SL(3) is the frontier and well-populated -- Heusener-Munoz-Porti arXiv:1505.04451 (five components of dimension 2, one containing the Sym^2 curve, two induced by exceptional Dehn fillings) and Falbel-Guilloux-Koseleff-Rouillier-Thistlethwaite arXiv:1412.4711 in PGL(3,C)/PSL(3,C) -- and NO E6, indeed no exceptional-group, character-variety work for knot or 3-manifold groups surfaced on either query. The 2026-07-04 finding therefore SURVIVES an independent re-search six weeks later, run from a seat that has search where the original did not. CONSEQUENCE: that row asked for TWO things, specialist confirmation of novelty AND a referee-grade write-up; the novelty half is now confirmable in-sandbox and confirmed twice, and the remaining half is a WRITE-UP, which is not a specialist wall but work this programme can do. The owner's thesis is vindicated on the highest-weight item in the register: what was parked as terminal and computation-exhausted turns out to be a search this seat can run and a document it can write. NOT CLAIMED: that two web searches are an exhaustive novelty sweep -- they are stronger than the original, which had none, and weaker than a specialist read, so a published novelty claim still wants an expert eye even though the gate AS WRITTEN is largely met; and not that the other five rows have expired -- B391 is the same shape and untested, while rho_n/Procesi, L22's Grobner engine, L5/L6 and L20 are genuine tooling-or-proof walls not examined here. Gate 5 untouched.
